title: Paige et al. 2011 LPI Volatiles 6058: Diviner polar annual average <38 K; excursions below 23 K
quote: The results show that the coldest regions on the Moon achieve annual average temperatures of less than 38K, and that surface temperature excursions below 23K are briefly observed.
note: Live URL. LEMS-A3 T_env OPEN cold bound is the coldest printed number: 'below 23K' (OPEN_below_printed, not a floor). Annual average <38 K is not the cold bound.
